concepts.title: Why Social Science: The Four Themes
concepts.definition: Social science studies human life through four connected themes: the land and people of India, the tapestry of the past, our cultural heritage and knowledge traditions, and governance with economic life around us.
concepts.key_idea: Society is studied through themes that link place, history, culture and governance.

concepts.title: Maps and the Globe
concepts.definition: A map is a drawing of a place as seen from above, using symbols and signs; a globe is a small round model of the Earth, and both help us locate places and see the world at a glance.
concepts.key_idea: Maps shrink large places onto paper so that streets, towns and countries can be studied together.

concepts.title: The Four Arrows: Directions on a Map
concepts.definition: The four arrows at the corner of a map point to the cardinal directions, north, south, east and west; they fix every place on the map relative to every other place.
concepts.key_idea: Directions turn a flat drawing into a usable map: once north is fixed, every other direction follows.

concepts.title: Society, Governance and Economic Life
concepts.definition: The introduction shows that society works because families, communities, governments and economic activities support one another; social science studies each strand and the threads that join them.
concepts.key_idea: No part of social life stands alone: living together needs governance, culture and work.

worked_examples.question_pattern: What does the globe teach us that a flat map cannot?

solution_template.explain: A globe is a round model of the Earth, so shapes and distances stay true.
Flat maps stretch or squeeze the round Earth, while the globe shows the whole planet at once.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Why do the four arrows matter when reading a city map?

solution_template.explain: The arrows mark the directions, so every place gets a position.
With north fixed, any street or landmark can be reached by naming turns towards east, west or south.
